result.summary: Analysis identified two visual concerns related to accessibility contrast and stylistic content choices.

issues.description: The white text on the light green promotional banner has insufficient color contrast, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Apply a darker text color to the banner content to improve legibility.

issues.description: Simplified vector illustrations are used for food items instead of high-quality photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder-style graphics with realistic food imagery to enhance user engagement.
